== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Tusken Raider (Japanese Premiere Two-Player)|Tusken Raider]] from [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.categoryonegames.com/catalog/star_wars_ccg-swccg_premiere_sw_2pg_japanese/tusken_raider_japanese_white_border/50652 CategoryOneGames], [https://cc-client-assets.cdn.crystalcommerce.com/photo/categoryonegames/file/e4babd070fec4fe985fbbcc9bc055cd9/IMG_20220607_0140.jpg source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(8, 10, 716, 1076)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>65202add35fc61f62844782e4fe183988a7abaebff069ca1bc2feac56a555fd0</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
